quest.title: The Snowy Past
quest.description: Paimon has an odd thought and drags you off to the Mondstadt alchemy shop...
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x60, Hero's Wit x3, Mora x30000

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, Timae— Huh, is that Albedo? Why is he leaving?

choices.text: (And why does he look so serious?)

response.speaker: Timaeus
response.text: Hey, it's the Traveler and Paimon!

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Hello, you two! It's been a long time!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Were you having a really serious discussion right now, or something?

response.speaker: Timaeus
response.text: Just a regular catch-up. We meet here once in a while to go through any recent developments in our research projects.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ugh, so we just missed him. Maybe we should have hollered to him...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: He didn't look in the best of moods just now, though. Was he upset about something? If so, he probably wouldn't have been in the mood to help out, anyway.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Huh... upset? You mean, Albedo?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah! He wasn't looking his usual self.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Upset... uh-oh, I wonder if...

response.speaker: Timaeus
response.text: Wh—What are you looking at me for?

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: I wonder if Timaeus's research topic is... so boring this time that Albedo finally snapped?

response.speaker: Timaeus
response.text: S—Surely not... It's not that boring! ...Is it?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe, nah! Anyway, Paimon wanted to ask you for a favor, Timaeus!

response.speaker: Timaeus
response.text: A favor? Haha, well sure! How can I help?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, Paimon found a bunch of super-duper sweet Sunsettias in the mountains the other day. But if Paimon eats them all, then they'll be gone, so Paimon isn't ready to finish them all yet...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon was thinking maybe you could make a device that you put fruits in, and it turns them into juice! That way, they'll be preserved for as long as Paimon needs!

response.speaker: Timaeus
response.text: I'm afraid that sort of thing... is a little, uh...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? Seems pretty straightforward to Paimon... can't you do it?

response.speaker: Timaeus
response.text: Hahaha. Paimon, I'm afraid you've entered into the realm of the weird and wonderful with this one...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Okay, so how about you, Sucrose? Any idea?

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: I'm sorry... it doesn't sound like it falls within my area of expertise. I could give it a try if you really want, but... I'd probably just end up giving all your precious fruits arms and legs.

response.speaker: Timaeus
response.text: Whoa... Your tone is so calm but your words are so terrifying. You'd think I'd be used to this by now...

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Well, as you know, my focus is on Bio-Alchemy... Besides, keeping things fresh forever is just not possible. If you just wanted to modify certain properties of the fruit or their seeds, on the other hand, I'd easily be able to help with that.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Alchemists usually focus in on their own research areas. Take us for example — Timaeus, Albedo, and I all have very different research foci.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Paimon, your idea is very imaginative... but it's beyond Timaeus's and my ability.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: I don't think even Albedo could make such an incredible device... After all, alchemy is not mechanics. There is a big difference between the two.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Sorry, I just don't know what has gotten into Paimon today.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh... Well, excuse Paimon for overestimating the power of alchemy...

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: In fact, before Albedo showed up, everyone in Mondstadt thought alchemy was useless.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Of course, we know better now. But even then, I have to admit that alchemy is only one of the many wondrous arts in the world. It's certainly not some kind of all-powerful magic that can simply take a substance and preserve it indefinitely... Ahem! Uh, sorry, that wasn't meant as a criticism against you personally...

choices.text: Don't blame yourself for Paimon's outlandishness.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: P—Paimon just wanted some fruit juice... What's wrong with that!?

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Oh, of course, these are just Timaeus's and my subjective opinions on the matter. If you're really intent on pursuing this wondrous device... you can try your luck asking Albedo.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: But I wouldn't get your hopes up. If he has no idea how to make one either, you'll have to give up on the idea.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm, he doesn't seem to be in a good mood today, though. What if he ignores us?

response.speaker: Timaeus
response.text: He won't. Albedo is not that kind of person.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: (But... there's something about Albedo today...)

response.speaker: Player
response.text: (Something seems different. What could it be?)

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey, so, where is Albedo heading to, anyway? Dragonspine?

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Unless he specifically says otherwise, Dragonspine is where he usually goes. He seems particularly fond of that place. And somehow, the cold doesn't seem to bother him at all.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Then let's go to Dragonspine to find him. C'mon, there's no time to lose!

choices.text: I will make sure to keep Paimon in check in the future.
Do you realize how absurd you sound right now?
(Did something happen?)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm? This looks lively, what's the occasion? Let's go and have a look!

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Hey, Traveler and Paimon! Fancy meeting you all the way out here.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Amber, Cyrus, Pallad... What's everyone doing at Dragonspine? Don't you mind the cold?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hi all. Long time no see.

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: Oh? The Traveler is joining us too. Great, fantastic, wonderful! Hahahaha, the more the merrier.

dialogues.speaker: Reckless Pallad
dialogues.text: I agree. I feel much better with the Traveler joining us. Definitely the kind of person you want to have around in a tight spot.

choices.text: Sorry, what have I walked into here?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, right! Paimon remembers most of these people are from the Adventurers' Guild... Then again, it seems a certain Outrider has joined too.

response.speaker: Cyrus
response.text: Hahaha... allow me to explain.

response.speaker: Cyrus
response.text: The Adventurers' Guild is holding winter training on Dragonspine.

response.speaker: Cyrus
response.text: As you know, our members have varying levels of adventure experience. Dragonspine is an excellent place for budding adventurers to challenge themselves and improve... but it's dangerous to go alone.

response.speaker: Cyrus
response.text: So, we made a plan for senior members to pair up with junior members. This way, everyone can experience training on Dragonspine together under safe and controlled circumstances.

response.speaker: Cyrus
response.text: Now, every adventurer can progress together. I have been working on this grand plan for half a year now, and it's finally coming together! Hahaha, it's a great plan, isn't it!?

response.speaker: Cyrus
response.text: #Hey, {NICKNAME}, you are an outstanding adventurer. Surely you must be willing to join us and help out?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Uh... Amber, what are you doing here?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Is the Adventurers' Guild short on experienced members?

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Well, that's part of it, actually...

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: The other reason is, when I was patrolling the perimeter of Dragonspine, I found a lost kid named Joel.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: I heard he lives here on the camp, so I escorted him back.

choices.text: I remember that kid...

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: I know. Joel's father went missing.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: I totally sympathize with how much Joel misses his family. Dragonspine is so bleak and deserted, it must have been so lonely for him here.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Aw, Amber...

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Anyway, I wanted to do something to cheer Joel up, so I said I'd build a snowman with him. It's something he enjoys doing.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: It also gives me a chance to stay here for a while and help Cyrus out.

choices.text: Since it's for Joel, count me in.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Aw, really? Thank you!

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Let's go meet up with Joel, then. Oh, I invited another friend of mine to join, too. She should be here any second. She'll be perfect for this kind of thing.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Hey, Cyrus, we've gotta take off. Is that okay?

response.speaker: Cyrus
response.text: No problem. Go ahead. I still have some final checks to make, so I will call you before we depart.

choices.text: Since it's you, Amber, count me in.
But... Joel's father...
What's the occasion?

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Hey, Joel, we're here.

choices.text: Hi, Joel!

response.speaker: Joel
response.text: Hi, everyone. Haha, I'm so happy right now! It's nice to have so many people to hang out with.

response.speaker: Joel
response.text: Are you here to build a snowman, too?

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Build... a snowman?

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Oh, sorry. I forgot to do the introductions.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: This is Eula, the Spindrift Knight and Captain of the Knights of Favonius Reconnaissance Company...

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Amber, you're being far too formal. The child is never going to remember all that.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Please, just call me Eula.

response.speaker: Joel
response.text: Okay, Aunty Eula! You can call me Joel.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Aunty... Eula...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh oh, Eula's gonna add that to her long list of scores to settle...

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: ...Alright, if that's what you want to call me, go right ahead.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whoa, Eula just let something go for once!

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Amber, what's this I hear about a snowman? I came to assist because you told me the Adventurers' Guild was short-handed.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Yeah, that's something else. But look, Joel's at that age where he should be having fun, and there's nothing to play with on Dragonspine.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: He used to build snowmen with his dad, and since his dad's not around, we're keeping him company instead.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Besides, Eula, it's gotta be more fun than taking an ice bath all by yourself.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Let's combine our forces and build ourselves a huge snowman! It'll be a ton of fun.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I approve.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yup yup, count Paimon in, too! Paimon wants to build a snowman.

response.speaker: Joel
response.text: Aunty Eula, are you too busy to join in?

response.speaker: Joel
response.text: If so, it's okay, I understand...

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: No, nothing like that. My mind was on something else, that's all. Building a snowman with Joel, are we? Sounds wonderful. I'd be delighted to join you.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Eula?

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Then let's get started! First, we need to split up into teams to gather some supplies!

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: #Joel and I will be on one team. {NICKNAME}, you and Eula can be on the other team.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Hey Joel, see that huge tree over there? Wanna race me there?

response.speaker: Joel
response.text: Yeah! Let's do it!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wow, those two are fast.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It's hard to tell which of them is having more fun.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey, what's up with you two? Why are you just staring at each other without saying anything?

choices.text: You're acting a little out of character...

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Umm... ahem, ahem...

choices.text: We are alone here. Just tell me.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Joel probably hasn't spent much of his life in the city.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: He doesn't know me... and he doesn't know what the Lawrence name means to people in Mondstadt.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Right, that's why he calls you Aunty Eula.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Careful, Paimon.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: ...True. In his eyes, I'm just another ordinary person from Mondstadt.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: It was a surprise, but not in a bad way at all.

choices.text: Then it's time to get building a snowman!

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Indeed. It's just...

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: *sigh* That's the thing. I'm a little worried that I won't be up to the challenge.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: I have never built a snowman before. My upbringing was very strict, so I never had the chance when I was a child.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: And after I grew up, of course, it's not the sort of thing I would spend my time doing.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh no, Paimon's starting to feel sorry for Eula.

choices.text: Take it easy. It's just for fun.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: ...You sound confident. Alright then.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Enough small talk for now. I see we have a member of the Adventurers' Guild joining us.

response.speaker: Cyrus
response.text: Greetings. We have a slight problem here. We've done a headcount and it turns out that we have an odd number of participants. In other words, we still have one instructor slot left to fill.

response.speaker: Cyrus
response.text: How it happened was, we originally asked Fischl to be an instructor, but she was busy with something outside of Mondstadt during this period. So we found another adventurer to fill in for her, but they still haven't shown up yet...

response.speaker: Cyrus
response.text: Thank goodness you are here. *sigh*

response.speaker: Gerald
response.text: Oh, hello. My name is Gerald, I'm a new adventurer...

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: In that case...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Eula can help.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Fine. But for that, you will pay.

response.speaker: Gerald
response.text: Huh? P—Pay for what? ...

choices.text: That's just how Eula talks...

response.speaker: Gerald
response.text: Okay, I—I got it. I'm ready and willing to learn!

response.speaker: Cyrus
response.text: Good, good. Then everything is settled. Thank you for your help, Eula.

response.speaker: Cyrus
response.text: #{NICKNAME}, if anybody else signs up later, I may have to ask for your help as well.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: No problem.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Why did you give the spot to Eula?

choices.text: I want people to know all the good qualities she has.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ohh, okay. Hehe, you're so nice. Paimon noticed Eula smiled just now, it must have meant a lot to her.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: To be honest, Eula really is the best candidate for an instructor. Most people would find it hard to cope on the mountain 'cause of the sheer cold, but not her.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh! Now Paimon gets it, this must be the whole reason why Amber got Eula involved in the first place!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We were supposed to find supplies, but now Eula's busy with other stuff and Paimon doesn't feel like going around collecting things... How do you think Amber and Joel are doing? Let's head up the mountain and see what they're up to!

choices.text: Eula desperately needs this kind of opportunity.
You're in safe hands with Eula...
Don't worry about it. The Honorary Knight will help you.
So there's something else bothering you?

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Hm. How very perceptive of you.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Were you staring at me the whole time when everyone was talking? You shan't be getting off lightly for that.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: The truth is, I'm a little concerned that I might be quite inept at building snowmen.

choices.text: There's no one else around. You can say.
I'm trying to figure out what you're thinking...
It's been a long time, Joel.

talks.objective: Go to Dragonspine and find Amber

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Strange. Didn't they say they were going this way? Where the heck are they?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Did we get here too late? Have they moved on already?

choices.text: Did you hear that...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh... C—Could they be in danger!?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hurry! Let's go check it out!

choices.text: I just heard a strange noise coming from up the mountain...

talks.objective: Follow the source of the voice
Follow the source of the voice
Follow the source of the voice

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The sound has completely stopped...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It looks like we lost it.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: How could that happen? After all the adventures we've been on, our tracking skills are honed to perfection, aren't they?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Guess we underestimated whatever was behind it, but if that's the case... then what exactly are we dealing with here?
I know that voice...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm? Huh?

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: What brings you to Dragonspine?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So it was just you.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ohh! So it was Albedo all along!

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: "All along"...? What do you mean by that?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: On the way here, we kept hearing weird noises and it felt like someone was watching us the whole time... Turns out it was just you.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Honestly, you really gave us the creeps! If you're bored up here, go find something useful to do — don't go sneaking around and scaring the poop out of people!

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: The things you felt and heard could easily be attributed to animals, or bandits perhaps. You should be wary at all times in this environment — there are all too many ways to sustain losses here if you aren't careful.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: So. What business brought you here?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It's a long story...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We actually came to look for you, but then it turned into looking for Amber, but now we've met you, so we're back to that again...

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Hmm. Your thought process is rather chaotic, as is the way in which you articulate it.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey! How dare you! All Paimon's trying to say is that we came here to look for you!

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Oh? Is that so?

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Then it must surely be something of great importance. I'm all ears.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Actually... it's nothing serious...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: He seems to be in a better mood than we thought, right? Does that mean Timaeus' stupidity doesn't really get to him after all?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We were probably overthinking it.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh... Okay, let's... let's just forget that ever came up!

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: It's okay if you can't tell me about it. Just treat this as an opportunity to stroll on the mountain and enjoy the view.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehehe. So basically, the truth is we're here on adventurer duty.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You tell Albedo about the event that the Adventurers' Guild is holding...

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: I see. So, you foisted the rookie off onto Eula, so that you could wander off and goof around?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We're not goofing around! And Eula was the right person for the job — we were just being nice.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What about you, then, huh? What're you doing on Dragonspine?

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: A friend commissioned me to do some artwork recently, and I have yet to finish. I came here because it's a quiet place where I can gather my thoughts, gather inspiration — and gather some raw materials while I'm at it.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Raw materials for what?

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Paint.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Starsilver can be used to make high-quality silver paint. I just ran out of my previous batch, so I'll collect some ore while I'm here.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ore can be used to make paint?

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Yes. But you have to be selective with the specimens you choose.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Even with a high level of impurities, Starsilver still contains fine silver-colored particles. But they lack luster, which impacts the color saturation of the pigment made from them. Paint made with such pigment is generally viewed as a fake or a defective product.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Interesting! So paint aside, can you talk about how you find inspiration? Paimon wants to learn!

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: You want to learn to paint?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #No, no, not for me, for the Traveler. Paimon wants {NICKNAME} to learn how to paint!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: During our travels, we sometimes have nights where there's nothing to do. It'd sure be nice to do something memorable rather than just sit around...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Painting is a great example, because it can capture a moment in time. So it seems like it's definitely a worthwhile skill to have.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So... you want me to learn to paint now?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yep! Why not? Once you've mastered it, you can paint Paimon!

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Not a bad idea. Well, since you two would like to learn more about painting, why don't you come with me to the campsite? I have painting materials there. You can practice while I give you some guidance.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Sounds great!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What about Amber...?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, she'll be fiiiine! She is a knight of Favonius after all. Let's just forget about all that stuff for now and go with Albedo.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Alright, fine...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: C'mon, let's go! It's so cold out — Paimon wants to get to the camp and warm up by the fire!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Aaaah!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's going on...?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Thieves! It's gotta be!

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Some things are missing.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Nothing valuable, hopefully? Wait, where's Paimon's Mora?

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: It's hard to say their value, but...

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Some of my alchemy notes are missing.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alchemy notes? Would they fetch a high price?

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: To the uninitiated, they are merely scraps of paper. But for someone who knows what they're doing... the knowledge contained in those notes is more valuable than any treasure.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So you're saying only someone who knows alchemy would've stolen them? But the only people who come to Dragonspine are adventurers, thieves, and monsters... What use would any of them have with your notes?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I don't think it's that simple.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: I feel the same way. However, hilichurl break-ins and other such incidents are not unheard-of on Dragonspine. It's difficult to draw a conclusion based solely on the evidence at hand.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Hmm? These appear to be...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Footprints?

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Fresh ones. Meaning, our thief can't have made it far.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's chase them down. We can't let 'em get away!

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: It feels like every time I try to drum up some enthusiasm for my idea, nobody wants to know. But whenever the young lass starts talking, everyone rallies behind her! ...What am I doing wrong?

dialogues.speaker: Reckless Pallad
dialogues.text: Hey, don't talk that way, Cyrus! You're the branch master! You're awesome!

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: Have you done anything apart from resting all day? Come on, are your supplies ready? Have you done your warm-up exercises? If not, then get to it, lad!

dialogues.speaker: Reckless Pallad
dialogues.text: Oh, uh, yeah! Sure!

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: Seriously!? Albedo doesn't like my alchemy device? It can create tiny ice crystals! I thought I had a good design here — I was planning to take it further...

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: Timaeus... it's not completely useless, but... perhaps it needs to be a little more original...

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: O—Okay... I see. I'll give it some more thought... Hmm, then again, what IS the use of this thing? I'm the one who came up with it, and even I can't think of a potential application...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, let's go see Timaeus. Paimon has a favor to ask him!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It'd be great if we could catch Sucrose and Albedo, too... but they seem really busy lately, so let's not get our hopes up.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Anyway, let's go see!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's coming from that direction!
